strings: On the Echo Isles, Zalazane's treachery has driven the Darkspear from their home. Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village sends Horde champions to end the witch doctor's rule. Dark magic drove Zalazane mad, and he enslaved his fellow tribesmen, seizing the Darkspear trolls' rightful home and forcing them into exile on Durotar's coast.

The Darkspear made a home on the Echo Isles after fleeing their sunken island and following Thrall across the Great Sea. The isles lie just off Durotar's southeast coast. Zalazane, once a respected and powerful witch doctor of the tribe, hungered for power. He used hexes to enslave the minds of his kin and began a violent uprising. Vol'jin led the Darkspear who remained free, but they were driven from their ancestral camps across the water. They had to build a temporary refuge at Sen'jin Village.

Zalazane still sends raiding parties from his hilltop stronghold on the largest Echo Isle. They cross the channel to seize more Darkspear and drag them under his control. The captured trolls become mindless voodoo and hexed thralls, lost to their tribe. Master Gadrin sees more than an occupation of Darkspear land: Zalazane threatens the tribe's survival. Until his severed head is brought before the elders, no Darkspear can be safe.

Zalazane was once a prominent witch doctor among the Darkspear trolls. Hunger for dark power corrupted him, and he turned on his kin, using mind-controlling voodoo to enslave them and seize the Echo Isles.
zalazane lore | who is the boss on echo isles | witch doctor zalazane
Why did the Darkspear flee the Echo Isles?

The Darkspear fled after Zalazane staged a surprise coup on the islands and used sorcery to turn their kin into mindless thralls. Vol'jin and the free Darkspear were too few to face their enchanted kin, so they retreated to mainland Durotar and founded Sen'jin Village as a temporary refuge.
why are trolls in sen'jin village | echo isles backstory | how did trolls lose echo isles
What happens to the trolls under Zalazane's control?

Hexes have robbed the trolls under Zalazane's control of their minds. They serve him, patrol the islands, and raid the mainland to capture more victims. Master Gadrin considers them lost to the tribe, with execution their only mercy.
hexed trolls | voodoo trolls | can zalazane's thralls be cured
Zalazane makes his lair on the largest Echo Isle, just east of Durotar's southern coast. He patrols from the high summit of its central hill down to the cluster of troll huts beneath it.
zalazane location | find zalazane | where is zalazane
Who gives the quest to kill Zalazane?
Master Gadrin, a tribal elder in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southern shore, asks you to kill Zalazane. You meet him after handling local threats and arriving from the Valley of Trials.
who starts zalazane | where to get zalazane quest
Why does Vol'jin not lead the assault himself?

Vol'jin rules the tribe and coordinates the Darkspear's defense alongside Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. In Sen'jin Village, elders such as Master Gadrin guide local survival, and Gadrin enlists capable adventurers to strike back at Zalazane.
where is vol'jin | why isn't vol'jin fighting zalazane
darkspear | durotar | echo isles | hexed troll | master gadrin | sen'jin village | vol'jin | voodoo troll | zalazane
As a shaman, you know the spiritual crafts and primal powers that troll shamans and witch doctors practice. Zalazane twists binding magic against his own kin.
As a member of the Horde, you help defend the displaced Darkspear. Allies from across Durotar rally to their cause in one of the young Horde's first major tests of unity.
As a Darkspear troll, you face a personal duty: punish the betrayer who stole your people's home and enslaved your kin.
Why does Master Gadrin want Zalazane killed?

Zalazane is not content with stealing the Echo Isles; he continually dispatches his enthralled trolls across the water to raid the mainland, enslaving more Darkspear to bolster his ranks. Master Gadrin knows that Sen'jin Village will never be safe as long as the rogue witch doctor lives to torment and abduct their people.
gadrin zalazane why | why kill zalazane | why does master gadrin want this

Master Gadrin demands Zalazane's severed head as undeniable proof of the witch doctor's demise. Only by seeing the head with his own eyes can Gadrin be certain that Zalazane's dark influence is broken and that the Darkspear tribe can finally sleep in peace.
zalazanes head purpose | why bring zalazanes head | zalazane head quest item

Margoz sends you into Skull Rock, east of Orgrimmar. Burning Blade cultists have overrun the cave and use painful demonic devices to bind themselves to dark magic. Margoz needs the cursed artifacts to study the cult's presence near the capital.

In northeastern Durotar, cultists gather close to Orgrimmar's gates. The cave lies among the hills, far from the open roads, yet near the Warchief's seat. The Burning Blade, a demonic cult that has long plagued orcish society, has made its home in the tunnels. Its followers perform rituals there while the Warchief's scouts watch nearby.

Burning Blade cultists wear Searing Collars around their necks, metal bands that scorch and brand their flesh. Margoz believes the pain and fel sorcery in the collars attune their wearers to demonic power. He asks you to recover the collars so he can study the spells and bindings that empower the cultists.

The Burning Blade's Searing Collars show that the cult is organized in Durotar. Its sorcery threatens the Horde's newly established territories. Margoz's study of the collars leads to further inquiries among the hidden circles of Orgrimmar.
Skull Rock lies in northeastern Durotar, east of Orgrimmar and north of Sen'jin Village. Its entrance is framed by a craggy cliffside along the shore.
skull rock location | where is skull rock | skull rock cave durotar

The Burning Blade is a cult of orcs and fel-worshipers devoted to demons and dark magic. Though the modern Horde broke from demonic servitude, splinter groups like the Burning Blade still practice forbidden rites and seek to corrupt the Horde from the shadows.
what is burning blade | who are burning blade cultists | burning blade lore
What do the cultists use the Searing Collars for?

Cultists wear Searing Collars around their necks, where the fiery metal burns their flesh. Margoz suspects the pain and demonic enchantment help them channel and attune themselves to dark fel energies.
searing collars purpose | why wear searing collars | what are searing collars
Margoz is an orcish hermit who lives in a small camp atop the bluffs of Durotar, near Skull Rock. He watches cultist movements along the coast and works to dismantle the Burning Blade's operations.
who is margoz | margoz durotar | margoz questgiver
Why does the Horde allow the cult so close to Orgrimmar?

The Horde does not knowingly tolerate the cult near Orgrimmar. Burning Blade followers hide in caves and desolate ravines beyond the reach of regular patrols, and adventurers investigate when the cult's rituals reveal its footholds.
why is skull rock near orgrimmar | orgrimmar burning blade nearby
What happens after Margoz examines the collars?
Margoz plans to examine the Searing Collars. His investigation continues with Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
next quest after skull rock | where do collars lead | margoz spell
burning blade | cultists | demonic | durotar | fel | margoz | orgrimmar | searing collar | skull rock
As a warlock, you can see how the Searing Collars bind their wearers with fel magic. Their crude enchantments show how the cult turns demonic sacrifice into power.
As a member of the Horde, you face a demonic cult entrenched just beyond Orgrimmar's walls, threatening the heart and security of your people.
As an orc, you face the Burning Blade as a remnant of the dark past your people fight to leave behind. Driving the cult from Durotar's rocks is a matter of survival and honor.
Why does Margoz want the Searing Collars?

Margoz believes that by burning their flesh with these collars, the cultists attune themselves to demonic forces. He needs a collection of intact collars to study and inspect with his magic, hoping to uncover the dark secrets behind the Burning Blade and expose how deep their demonic corruption runs.
why does margoz need collars | margoz searing collars motive | why collect searing collars
Who are you sent against in Skull Rock?

You are dispatched against the cultists of the Burning Blade hiding inside Skull Rock, a cavern east of Orgrimmar. They have gathered there beneath the Horde's nose to perform vile rituals, bind themselves to demonic masters, and plot against the safety of Durotar.
who is in skull rock | skull rock enemies | burning blade cultists skull rock
After Rin'ji's Secret, the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! comes to its close with Oran Snakewrithe, to whom you bring a tablet.
Rin'ji is Trapped! began this chain, and Rin'ji's Secret was the step just before this one. Oran Snakewrithe is the one who receives the tablet you carry.

Oran asks where the tablet turned up, and you tell of a small island, deserted, at the Overlook Cliffs. Oran finds this very interesting, puts the tablet carefully away, and says the Dark Lady will be very pleased with the discovery.
Oran Snakewrithe is the one who closes the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! and went on through Rin'ji's Secret.
oran | who is oran | oran snakewrithe lore
What comes before this in the chain?
Before it comes Rin'ji's Secret, and before that Rin'ji is Trapped!.
previous quest | prereq for oran's gratitude | how to start oran's gratitude

In northern Durotar, Margoz watches for the Burning Blade's growing threat. After the clash with fel corruption at Thunder Ridge, Orgnil Soulscar sends champions to seek the isolated orc shaman before they strike a nearby cultist stronghold. Margoz's counsel reveals Skull Rock, the Burning Blade's concealed cavern base.

After Thunder Ridge revealed the depth of fel taint, Orgnil Soulscar sees that strength alone cannot cleanse Durotar. He sends champions to Margoz, an experienced orc shaman keeping a lonely camp in the crags northeast of Razor Hill. Between Drygulch Ravine and the eastern sea, Margoz watches the northern reaches for dark omens that Orgrimmar's busy warriors often miss.

Margoz knows the Burning Blade's power base in northern Durotar: Skull Rock, a concealed cavern system carved into the mountain cliffs outside Orgrimmar's southern gates. The cultists are closer to Thrall's capital than the Warchief's guards realize, and Skull Rock's hidden passages can conceal a demonic ambush. Margoz gives those sent against the coven counsel so they do not enter blindly.
Margoz is an experienced orc shaman loyal to the Horde, keeping a secluded camp in northeastern Durotar. He studies dark magic and watches the demonic corruption spreading through the region.
margoz lore | who is margoz | margoz npc
You can find Margoz at his camp in the rugged hills of northeastern Durotar, between Drygulch Ravine and the eastern coastline, southeast of Orgrimmar.
margoz location | find margoz | where is margoz
Why does Orgnil Soulscar send me to Margoz?

Orgnil Soulscar sends you to Margoz because the shaman has studied the local Burning Blade cultists. Before you assault their stronghold, Orgnil wants you to receive Margoz's spiritual wisdom and practical counsel.
why speak with margoz | orgnil soulscar margoz

Skull Rock is a concealed system of mountain caves just south of Orgrimmar's eastern walls. It is a fortified Burning Blade coven where demon-worshiping cultists conduct rituals close to the Horde's capital.
skull rock lore | what is skull rock
When you report to Margoz, he acknowledges your growing strength and sends you into Skull Rock to slay the cultists and recover their corrupted insignia.
next quest after margoz | margoz follow up
Is Margoz part of the Burning Blade?
No. Margoz is a devoted Horde shaman who works to purge demonic influence and keep young champions on an honorable, uncorrupted path.
is margoz evil | is margoz a cultist
burning blade | drygulch ravine | durotar | margoz | orgnil soulscar | orgrimmar | shaman | skull rock
As a shaman, you can see Margoz's patient wisdom in his watch on the wilderness margins, where he senses spiritual corruption before it becomes war.
As a member of the Horde, you can hear Margoz's warning: demon cults lurk within striking distance of Orgrimmar.
As an orc, meeting Margoz reminds you of fel power's lingering temptation and urges the new generation toward a pure, honorable path.

In Orgrimmar, Neeru Fireblade studies dark arts he says can protect the Horde. Margoz sends you from Durotar with a Searing Collar taken from the Burning Blade cult, hoping the warlock can explain its demonic power.

Margoz has found the limit of shamanic arts. The collars taken from Burning Blade cultists at Skull Rock carry demonic sorcery, beyond what he can unravel. Shamans draw on the elements and ancestral spirits, so Margoz sends you to a warlock in the capital to learn what the collars do.

Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow lies beneath its red cliffs. Warlocks and other practitioners of forbidden magic work there under Thrall's wary eye. Neeru Fireblade lives in the cavern and says he studies fel power to thwart demonic threats. When you bring him the collar, his curiosity turns Durotar's investigation toward the warlock enclave.
Why does Margoz send me to a warlock?

Margoz is a shaman, drawing power from the elements and ancestral spirits. The Searing Collars from Skull Rock are demonic, so he needs someone trained in fel magic and the dark arts to understand their enchantments and origins.
why warlock | why neeru | margoz warlock
Where can I find Neeru Fireblade?
You can find Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, where warlocks, rogues, and shadow casters gather.
neeru location | where is neeru fireblade | cleft of shadow neeru

Margoz doubts Neeru's claims that his occult research is benign and meant to fight demons. Thrall permits warlocks in Orgrimmar under strict supervision, but whether Neeru can be trusted remains uncertain.
is neeru evil | neeru trustworthy | can i trust fireblade
The Example Collar is one of the Searing Collars taken from Burning Blade cultists at Skull Rock. Margoz gives it to you to bring to Neeru Fireblade for magical study.
example collar | what is the collar | searing collar quest item
What happens after giving the collar to Neeru?
Neeru examines the collar closely and sends you deeper into the investigation of the cult's presence in Durotar, beginning the search for Ak'Zeloth.
next quest after neeru | what does neeru do | quest chain after neeru
Why does the Horde allow warlocks in Orgrimmar?

Thrall allows warlocks in Orgrimmar out of pragmatic necessity. He keeps them in the Cleft of Shadow, where their dangerous research can be watched, controlled, and sometimes used to understand demonic enemies.
why are warlocks allowed | warlocks in cleft of shadow | thrall warlocks
burning blade | cleft of shadow | durotar | margoz | neeru fireblade | orgrimmar | searing collar | skull rock | warlock
As a shaman, you know the elements will not commune with fel artifacts. Margoz has reached the boundary of his craft and needs a warlock's help.
As a warlock, you meet Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar's most prominent warlock. Your forbidden craft has practical use to the Horde.
As a member of the Horde, you see a fragile truce in Orgrimmar: the Warchief's shamans sometimes rely on the shadowy outcasts of the Cleft of Shadow to protect Durotar.
Why does Margoz send you instead of going himself?

Margoz remains stationed outside Razor Hill keeping watch over Durotar's spiritual unrest. You are the adventurer who recovered the Searing Collars from Skull Rock in the first place, proving your capability in dealing with the cult's dark artifacts. Because he cannot divine their demonic workings through shamanism alone, he relies on you to carry a sample swiftly to the Cleft of Shadow.
why me margoz | why send me to neeru | why doesn't margoz go to orgrimmar

At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs cloth for her tailoring. She asks passing adventurers to hunt Defias bandits and take their linen bandanas, then uses the cloth to make goods for travelers.

Defias bandits across Elwynn wear red linen bandanas. Their less organized kin in Northshire Valley make do with cheap burlap masks. For local craftsmen short on materials, the bandanas offer cloth they can use.

Sara Timberlain works as a seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp, near Elwynn's eastern border. She needs workable textiles for her trade, so she asks adventurers to thin the Defias camps scattered through the woods. The cloth keeps her tailoring supplied while the bandits' encroachment on the area is checked.
Who offers the Red Linen Goods quest?
Sara Timberlain, a seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest, offers the work.
who gives red linen goods | red linen goods questgiver | sara timberlain quest
What items are needed for Red Linen Goods?
You need six Red Linen Bandanas from Defias gang members scattered throughout Elwynn Forest.
what do i collect for red linen goods | items for red linen goods | bandanas needed
Where can I find Defias bandits in Elwynn Forest?
Defias outlaws camp across Elwynn Forest, including around Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Stonefield Farm, and the woods around Jerod's Landing.
defias locations elwynn | where are defias camps | where to get red bandanas
Why do the Elwynn Defias wear linen instead of burlap?
Low-ranking Defias in Northshire wear burlap masks, while better-equipped members across Elwynn wear red linen. The bandanas mark the Brotherhood's higher level of organization and supply.
why red linen | burlap vs linen defias | defias mask material
Why does Sara Timberlain want bandit bandanas?
Sara Timberlain needs fabric for her tailoring. She reuses linen from the Defias masks to sew practical goods for woodsmen and travelers at the logging camp.
why collect bandanas | what does sara do with masks
Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp located?
Eastvale Logging Camp lies in far eastern Elwynn Forest, just north of the main road toward the bridge into Redridge Mountains.
eastvale location | where is eastvale | how to find sara timberlain
burlap | defias brotherhood | eastvale logging camp | elwynn forest | red linen bandana | red linen goods | sara timberlain | tailoring
As an Alliance traveler, you can weaken the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn while bringing useful cloth to Eastvale.
As a tailor, you see how scarce fabric can lead a seamstress to salvage cloth from bandits' clothing.
What is the Red Linen Bandana used for?

The red linen bandanas are worn as masks by Defias Brotherhood bandits prowling throughout Elwynn Forest. While the scoundrels in Northshire make do with rough burlap, the thieves in the broader forest carry better-grade cloth. Sara Timberlain unravels and reweaves these captured masks to craft serviceable linen garments.
what is red linen bandana for | red linen bandana use | why red linen bandana
Why are Defias bandits in Elwynn Forest?

The Defias Brotherhood has established camps scattered across Elwynn Forest to harass travellers, rob supply lines, and undermine Stormwind's authority. Their growing presence threatens local settlements like the Eastvale Logging Camp, taking advantage of the kingdom's stretched guard forces to expand their outlaw operations right outside the capital.
defias in elwynn | why are defias here | defias brotherhood elwynn forest
Why does Sara Timberlain need you instead of the guards?

Sara Timberlain is a tailor at the Eastvale Logging Camp, not a soldier, and she lacks the means to fight outlaws herself. Stormwind's guards and the local garrison are already overburdened trying to contain widespread Defias incursions and gnoll raids, leaving humble artisans to rely on passing adventurers for materials and protection.
why ask me sara | why not elwynn guards | why timberlain need help

Recovered from a locked strongbox atop Tiragarde Keep, these weathered papers bear the personal seal of the late Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. The recovered orders reveal that the Kul Tiran human garrison along Durotar's coast is far more entrenched and organized than simple shipwreck survivors. Delivering them to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill exposes lingering military plans threatening the fledgling Orc nation.

Hidden inside a heavy chest on the upper floors of Tiragarde Keep, an aged envelope survives under the watch of Lieutenant Benedict. Sealed with the crest of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, the parchment outlines direct naval commands issued during Kul Tiras's bloody invasion of Durotar. Even after the Grand Admiral fell at Theramore, his officers maintained their fortifications, clinging tightly to their mission to eradicate the Horde settlement.

Bringing the recovered documents to Gar'Thok, commander of Razor Hill, confirms the worst fears of the local defense force. The human forces entrenched along the eastern shoreline are not aimless castaways, but an established beachhead awaiting reinforcement. Gar'Thok immediately recognizes that dismantling the Tiragarde command structure is an urgent matter of survival for Durotar.
Where are the Admiral's Orders found?

The orders are found inside an Aged Envelope stored within a locked chest on the third floor of Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. To open the chest, you must first defeat Lieutenant Benedict on the second floor to claim his key.
orders location | where is aged envelope | find admirals orders

Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore was the ruler of Kul Tiras and supreme commander of the Alliance naval fleet during the Second War. Refusing to believe orcs could ever live peacefully, he sailed to Kalimdor to wage a war of extermination against Durotar before meeting his demise at Theramore.
who is the admiral | daelin proudmoore lore | who issued orders
Why are Kul Tiran soldiers still in Tiragarde Keep?

When Daelin Proudmoore invaded Durotar, he established fortified coastal footholds like Tiragarde Keep. Following his defeat, surviving officers and marines under Lieutenant Benedict held their posts, determined to continue his campaign against the Horde.
why are humans in durotar | tiragarde keep soldiers | kul tiras in durotar
Why is Gar'Thok so concerned about these orders?

As military commander of Razor Hill, Gar'Thok is tasked with safeguarding central Durotar. Discovering organized naval orders proves that Tiragarde Keep poses an active, calculated military threat to the orcish homeland rather than disorganized, stranded survivors.
gar'thok reaction | why does garthok care
Who holds the key to the Admiral's chest?
Lieutenant Benedict, the commanding Kul Tiran officer situated on the second level of Tiragarde Keep, carries the key required to unlock the strongbox containing the Aged Envelope.
What happens after giving the orders to Gar'Thok?

Upon inspecting the orders, Gar'Thok recognizes the danger: Proudmoore's plans were laid out before his death, and more waves of his men may yet land on Durotar's shores. He sends the orders on to Orgrimmar at once so the Warchief's council is warned.
admirals orders follow up | next quest
admirals orders | aged envelope | daelin proudmoore | gar'thok | kul tiras | lieutenant benedict | razor hill | tiragarde keep

Uncovering Proudmoore's orders proves that the Alliance presence on Durotar's shores was an orchestrated campaign of extermination, reinforcing why the Horde must defend its newfound home with vigilance.
For the orcs fighting to build a future in Durotar, these documents are a stark reminder of Daelin Proudmoore's relentless hatred and the remnants who still seek their destruction.
Jesper lies sick in Stormwind during Hallow's End, longing for the treats and fun beyond the orphanage. Too ill to go out, he asks Alliance adventurers to gather sweets for him.

Jesper stays in the orphanage in Stormwind's Cathedral Square, sick during Hallow's End. He cannot enjoy the childhood pleasure of gathering sweets across Azeroth, so he hopes passing adventurers will share the holiday spirit and collect treats for him.
Tricks for Treats Across the Alliance

To bring Jesper the sweets he hopes for, you travel beyond Elwynn Forest. You visit the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, along with the gnome exile Talvash del Kissel. Each asks you to perform before giving you a treat. You cluck like a chicken, dance, flex, or chug like a train, earning regional sweets such as Stormwind Nougat and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.
Jesper is a young orphan in the Stormwind orphanage. During Hallow's End, he longs for holiday candy but is too sick to gather it himself.
jesper stormwind | orphan jesper | who is jesper
Why can't Jesper go trick-or-treating himself?
Jesper is sick, so he must stay inside the orphanage while the rest of the city celebrates Hallow's End.
why can't jesper leave | is jesper sick | jesper trick or treat
Jesper asks for four regional sweets: Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mints, Darnassus Marzipan, and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.
jesper treats | hallows end treats list | jesper candy needed
Where do you obtain the Gnomeregan Gumdrop?
Talvash del Kissel gives out Gnomeregan Gumdrops while staying in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.
gnomeregan gumdrop location | who gives gumdrop | talvash candy
What tricks do the innkeepers make you perform?
The innkeepers ask you to flex in Stormwind, dance in Darnassus, cluck like a chicken in Ironforge, and make a train noise for Talvash.
hallow's end tricks | innkeeper tricks | trick for treats alliance
What does Jesper give you in return for the candy?
After receiving all four holiday candies, Jesper gives the traveler some pumpkin treats he has saved.
jesper reward | treats for jesper completion
darnassus | gumdrop | hallow's end | ironforge | jesper | marzipan | nightingale | nougat | stormwind | talvash | trick-or-treat
For the Alliance, this holiday brings distant capitals together. You travel from Stormwind's grand streets to Ironforge's mountain halls and Darnassus's boughs to bring joy to an orphaned child.
As a gnome, your home is lost to troggs and radiation. In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel keeps Gnomeregan Gumdrops part of the holiday.
Why does Jesper want the Hallow's End treats collected?

Jesper is a sick orphan confined to the Stormwind orphanage under the watchful eye of Matron Nightingale, leaving him unable to join the Hallow's End celebrations across the Alliance capitals. To experience the holiday like any other child, he hopes to taste the festive sweets unique to each allied capital, offering a trade of his own pumpkin treats so he does not miss out entirely.
why does jesper want treats | jesper motivation candy | why hallows end treats jesper
What is the Stormwind Nougat for?

Stormwind Nougat is a traditional local confection handed out by the Trade District's innkeeper during Hallow's End. It represents the human kingdom's contribution to the festival treats Jesper wants you to gather for him, earned by showing off your strength to the innkeeper.
stormwind nougat use | what is stormwind nougat | who wants stormwind nougat
What is the Gnomeregan Gumdrop for?

The Gnomeregan Gumdrop is a signature sweet distributed on behalf of the exiled gnomes by Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. It is one of the four unique sweets Jesper asks you to gather so he can taste the festive treats of all the Alliance peoples.
gnomeregan gumdrop use | what is gnomeregan gumdrop | who wants gnomeregan gumdrop
What is the Ironforge Mint for?

The Ironforge Mint is a dwarven confectionery treat given away by the innkeeper of Ironforge during the autumn holiday. Jesper needs it as part of his complete four-city collection of Hallow's End candies, awarded after humoring the innkeeper with a spirited chicken impression.
ironforge mint use | what is ironforge mint | who wants ironforge mint
What is the Darnassus Marzipan for?

Darnassus Marzipan is an exquisite night elf confection handed out by the innkeeper of Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. It completes the assortment of regional Hallow's End delicacies that Jesper longs to enjoy while stuck in the Stormwind orphanage.
darnassus marzipan use | what is darnassus marzipan | who wants darnassus marzipan

Hallow's End Treats for Spoops! is a seasonal quest where an adventurer gathers holiday sweets on behalf of Spoops, who is too ill to go trick-or-treating. In exchange for treats gathered from city innkeepers and Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village, Spoops offers magical candy that transforms the eater into funny and frightening shapes.

Hallow's End brings celebration, mischief, and festive confections across the realm, but not everyone can join the festivities outdoors. Spoops is stuck inside due to illness while the rest of the world partakes in the revelry. Unable to roam the streets, Spoops enlists wandering travelers to venture forth and gather treats on their behalf, offering a curious stash of shape-shifting confections in return.
Tricks and Treats Across the Realm

Securing the treats requires a journey across the realm's settlements. Major city innkeepers hold stashes of festival candy, though they demand visitors show their holiday spirit with tricks before parting with their sweets. Beyond the bustling city taverns, the tradition extends even to the coastal shores of Durotar, where Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village distributes treats to those making the trek.

Spoops is a sick young person who is unable to go out trick-or-treating during Hallow's End. Wanting to participate in the holiday, Spoops asks travelers to collect seasonal treats from innkeepers and vendors across the world on their behalf.
who is spoops | spoops | what is spoops

Spoops is unwell and too sick to venture outside to celebrate Hallow's End. Because illness keeps them bedridden, they rely on helpful adventurers to make the rounds to the various city innkeepers and collect holiday sweets.
why cant spoops go trick or treating | why is spoops staying in | spoops sick
What candy does Spoops offer in exchange?

In exchange for the holiday sweets collected from innkeepers, Spoops promises special candies that have magical, transformative properties. Eating them can turn you into various creatures and forms that are both comical and frightening.
what candy does spoops give | spoops reward candy | special candy
Where do you find the treats for Spoops?

Holiday candy is distributed by innkeepers located throughout the capital cities, who ask travelers to perform tricks in exchange for treats. In addition to the urban taverns, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village hands out seasonal sweets.
where do i get candy | who gives treats | candy locations
Kali Remik is a troll living in Sen'jin Village in Durotar who participates in Hallow's End by handing out holiday candy to festive travelers who stop by.
who is kali remik | kali remik candy | senjin village candy
Why do innkeepers ask for tricks?
During Hallow's End, innkeepers in major settlements require visitors to demonstrate their holiday spirit by performing various silly tricks or gestures before they will share their holiday sweets.
